# WaterEjector Project

This repository contains a static Single Page Application (SPA) utility called WaterEjector. It helps users eject water and remove dust from their device's speakers by playing specific high-frequency sound waves.

## Technology Stack
- HTML5
- CSS3 (Vanilla, CSS Variables for theming)
- JavaScript (Vanilla, Web Audio API)

## Architecture
- `index.html`: The main page with the tool interface.
- `style.css`: Contains all styles including the premium Gold color theme.
- `script.js`: Handles UI interactions and the Web Audio API logic (oscillators, gains, frequencies).
- Folder structure contains other informational pages (About, Contact, Terms of Service, Privacy Policy, etc.) for SEO and AdSense readiness.
